Our earthquake warning system also allows for preventative measures that mitigate damages to critical electricity, water and gas infrastructure throughout the municipality. PREPARE BETTER, RECOVER FASTER Triggering vital preventive actions, SeismicAI earthquake warning system capabilities allows the organization to be better prepared for a seismic event. With real-time alerts, precise impact insights, and emergency check-ins, ShakeWatch ensures your facility, operations are team are always prepared. Gain the confidence of knowing your organization is always one step ahead of seismic threats. At the current stage, ShakeWatch earthquake alert app's coverage is relevant only for SeismicAI customers in 7 states in Mexico - Chiapas, Oaxaca, Guerrero, Michoacan, Jalisco, Colima, Puebla, Morelos, Estado de Mexico, and Ciudad de Mexico. Additional areas in Mexico, Italy, and other countries will follow. ShakeWatch app is available only as part of the SeismicAI product suite. JOIN SHAKEWATCH 02 Ultra-fast, accurate alerts Powered by SeismicAI’s real-time seismic technology, ShakeWatch earthquake alert app delivers lightning-fast, highly accurate alerts, so your team can act before the shaking starts. SeismicAI’s accuracy prevents false alarms and unnecessary business interruptions and provides clear, actionable data when it matters most. Monitor up to three locations Track up to three key locations and receive alerts where the risk is highest. Whether your team is in the office, or elsewhere, ShakeWatch ensures they stay informed and ready to respond. ShakeWatch alerts only on earthquakes affecting your selected sites, to support your business continuity. 03 Countdown to Impact Alerts include a countdown timer, estimated shaking intensity, and projected effects based on the Modified Mercalli Intensity (MMI) scale. This critical data helps your team prepare, helping to mitigate risks and safeguard lives. JOIN SHAKEWATCH 04 Emergency Check-Ins After an earthquake, ShakeWatch earthquake alert app allows employees to report their status within 24 hours: “I’m safe” or “I need help”. It automatically shares location with emergency contacts to accelerate rescue efforts. With this feature, organizations can quickly assess the situation and take action where needed, ensuring no one is left behind. 05 A Perfect fit for your Organization ShakeWatch earthquake alert app is designed for companies and organizations that prioritize safety. It integrates seamlessly with SeismicAI’s web app, enabling administrators to monitor employee safety in real time, coordinate response efforts, and improve emergency preparedness. Available for iOS and Android, ShakeWatch is easy to set up and use, ensuring your team is protected with minimal effort. JOIN SHAKEWATCH 06 How it Works Real time alerting ShakeWatch alerts on seismic activity in your saved locations, issuing warnings on potential threats with high precision to minimize false alarms. instant alerts Receive push notifications with a countdown timer, providing a warning before the destructive waves hit. the insights you need View the earthquake’s location, magnitude, and estimated effects—all in one place—to support business continuity efforts. Also, view a list of past earthquakes. 07 Stay prepaed, stay secure ShakeWatch earthquake alert app gives your organization the confidence of always being ready. With a reliable early warning system, real-time tracking, and an intuitive design, earthquake preparedness becomes simple and effective JOIN SHAKEWATCH 08 ShakeWatch FAQ SeismicAI is committed to helping you stay safe and informed. For questions about how to use ShakeWatch earthquake alert app and technical information, view our FAQ page. That’s why SeismicAI offers a suite of Earthquake Early Warning Applications that scales with your needs. Whether you’re focused on real-time alerts, automated safety actions, operational visibility, or recovery insights — our platform gives you the tools to protect your team, assets, and business continuity, in the way that works best for you. Choose the right product level for today — Safe, Safe+, SafePro — and gain access to an evolving set of applications that support your goals, without paying for tools you don’t need. Your Seismic Safety Toolkit – Multiple Paths to Protection The SeismicAI suite comprises modular Earthquake Early Warning applications and products, each designed to handle a different aspect of earthquake readiness — from alert delivery to command and control to post-event analysis. As you scale up, more capabilities become available. 02 ShakeLink: The Core of SeismicAI ShakeLink is an on-site IoT earthquake alert solution, that serves as an alert and integration unit for your facility’s protection. ShakeLink is the real-time responder: • Delivers ultra-fast audiovisual alerts from SeismicAI’s global detection network. • Can trigger automated proactive actions (Safe and Pro tiers) • Integrates with your infrastructure (Safe and Pro tiers) • Continuously monitors its own health, reporting any issues for proactive maintenance. No matter the product level, ShakeLink is the essential building block that powers earthquake alerts for your site. DOWNLOAD ONEPAGER 03 ShakeWatch: Mobile Alerts in Real Time All product levels include access to the ShakeWatch earthquake alert mobile app — allowing your team to receive alerts based on their current location, and two additional locations selected by the organization. Users can check-in to the app as safe or unsafe, helping emergency teams locate those at risk. Learn about ShakeWatch 04 ShakeCommand: Multi-Site Visibility For distributed organizations managing multiple facilities, ShakeCommand offers a web-based dashboard that provides real-time updates across your entire network. • Monitor earthquakes as they unfold • See per-site impact projections • Track hardware and system health • Coordinate emergency responses from a single interface ShakeCommand is available for customers with over 10 sites at Safe+ and SafePro levels. Learn about ShakeCommand 05 ShakeReport: Smart Recovery Starts with Data Available with the SafePro tier and optional for Safe+ tier, ShakeReport delivers a post-earthquake impact assessment just 30 minutes after an event. Generated from real on-site sensor data, the report offers actionable insights that help you decide whether it’s safe to resume operations, or initiate further inspections. • Understand structural impact • Prioritize recovery actions • Communicate clearly with leadership and regulators • Accelerate back-to-business All product levels and applications are backed by professional installation, 24/7 support, system monitoring, and automatic upgrades — so you’re always protected and up to date. Learn about ShakeReport 06 Built for Business. Backed by Science SeismicAI gives you an end-to-end solution for earthquake resilience. Our earthquake early warning applications are custom-configured for each organization, adapting to your operational needs, and evolving with you. It issues real-time alerts before the destructive shaking starts, providing valuable time to take cover and reduce risk. download SHAKEWATCH 02 Covering Previously Unprotected Areas in Mexico In many regions across Mexico, reliable earthquake alerts are still unavailable or inconsistent. ShakeWatch addresses this gap by bringing reliable early warning technology to families and individuals in those areas helping you stay informed and prepared. SeismicAI coverage in Mexico currently includes only Chiapas, Oaxaca, Guerrero, Michoacán, Jalisco, Colima, Puebla, Morelos, Estado de México, and Ciudad de México. Additional regions will also be included soon. 03 Trusted Worldwide ShakeWatch is powered by SeismicAI’s innovative real-time seismic technology, trusted globally by governments and large organizations to protect people, infrastructure, and critical operations. That same proven technology now works to protect you and your loved ones, continuously analyzing seismic signals and issuing alerts when shaking is expected to reach your location. download SHAKEWATCH 04 All the information you need When an alert is issued, ShakeWatch provides a clear countdown to expected shaking, along with the shaking intensity and projected effects based on the Modified Mercalli Intensity (MMI) scale. This information helps you quickly understand what’s coming and take life-saving actions. 05 More value for less ShakeWatch makes earthquake early warning accessible to everyone. For an affordable cost, you receive the same precision and speed trusted by governments and major organizations around the world. This means faster alerts, fewer false alarms, and clear information, delivering greater value for less. download SHAKEWATCH 06 Stay connected after an earthquake After an earthquake, ShakeWatch helps you reconnect with the people who matter most. The app allows you to check in as safe or indicate that you need help, and share your location with emergency contacts. This makes it easier for loved ones to know your status and accelerate emergency efforts if needed. 07 Protect the places that matter ShakeWatch monitors your home and your real time location. Alerts are sent only when an earthquake is expected to affect those locations, keeping notifications relevant and focused, and minimizing false alerts. download SHAKEWATCH 08 ShakeWatch FAQ SeismicAI is committed to helping you stay safe and informed. For questions about how to use ShakeWatch earthquake alert app and technical information, view our FAQ page.
